items.title: ActiveCloud (Belarus) — cloud infrastructure encrypted
items.summary: Belarusian cloud provider ActiveCloud disclosed on Nov 11 that ransomware encrypted parts of its cloud infrastructure; most services were restored by Nov 13 and it reports no evidence of customer data theft.

items.title: Leware Construction — claimed by Storm-1567
items.summary: US construction firm listed on a leak site with an attack date of Nov 11, 2026; claim not independently confirmed.

items.title: Advantage Archives Inc. — claimed by Ransom group
items.summary: Records-management company posted as a victim on a ransomware leak site this month; claim only, no victim statement found.

items.title: Everest posts 'final notice before publication' victim
items.summary: Everest listed an unnamed victim with an attack date of Nov 13, 2026, threatening data publication.

items.title: Ransomware volumes up 23% — industry trend
items.summary: Industry data shows ransomware attack counts rising roughly 23% year over year heading into Q4 2026.

ransomware.note: Thin named-victim coverage this cycle; most entries are leak-site claims (SOCRadar tracker), not confirmed incidents.

items.title: Microsoft 365 multi-region disruption (Nov 12–13)
items.summary: Microsoft 365 services were disrupted for businesses, government and healthcare across several regions; AI vendors reported Microsoft connector failures. Not reflected on Azure status history.

items.title: Outlook, Google and other services degraded (Nov 13)
items.summary: Macwelt reported significant problems reaching Outlook/Microsoft 365, Google and other online services on Nov 13.

items.title: Google Cloud europe-west2-b power loss (Oct 20) — post-incident
items.summary: A third-party London facility hosting a Google Cloud zone lost utility power and a controller fault blocked generator failover — a textbook BCDR single-point-of-failure case.

items.title: AWS publishes no 2026 post-event summaries
items.summary: Tracker notes AWS has not published a PES for any 2026 incident, leaving customers reliant on press reports for RCA.

outage.note: No major AWS/Azure/GCP platform-wide outage found in the past 7 days; M365 incident is the headline.

items.title: CISA adds GPUStack, FreeSWITCH, OpenSSH, IBM Aspera Faspex to KEV
items.summary: Four actively exploited flaws added Nov 9 with an unusually short Nov 12 federal remediation and forensic-triage deadline.

items.title: Node2Shell critical flaw now exploited
items.summary: CISA warned that attackers are actively exploiting the critical Node2Shell vulnerability and ordered agencies to patch.

items.title: Ivanti Connect Secure flaws — KEV deadline Nov 13
items.summary: Two Ivanti Connect Secure CVEs added to KEV with a Nov 13 deadline; VPN edge devices remain a prime initial-access target.

items.title: Metabase zero-day enables admin takeover and data exfiltration
items.summary: CISA listed a Metabase flaw (CVE-2026-72898) letting unauthenticated attackers gain admin and exfiltrate data, alongside Windows and Cisco Secure Firewall entries.

items.title: Cisco zero-days prompt CISA Emergency Directive, Five Eyes alert
items.summary: CISA issued an emergency directive with Five Eyes partners over exploited Cisco zero-days.

items.title: APT29 targets older iPhones — Apple flaw added to KEV
items.summary: Apple CVE-2024-27834 added to KEV as APT29 exploits unpatched older iPhones; federal due date Nov 18.

items.title: Zyxel switch zero-day used to hijack 996 devices
items.summary: Attackers used CVE-2026-107441 to take over nearly 1,000 Zyxel switches.

items.title: M 6.6 — 148 km WSW of Tual, Indonesia (Nov 16)
items.summary: Strong offshore Banda Sea quake; USGS green alert, no tsunami.

items.title: M 5.3 — Vrancea, Romania (Nov 18)
items.summary: Intermediate-depth quake 16 km ESE of Comandău felt across Romania; no tsunami.

items.title: Cyclone Murasu lands on Andhra Pradesh coast
items.summary: Second cyclone in under a week to make landfall on India's Andhra Pradesh coast (Nov 3).

items.title: Ecuador nationwide flooding — 12 dead, 56,000+ affected
items.summary: Heavy rains and flooding across Ecuador killed 12 and affected over 56,000 people as of Nov 5.

items.title: Santa Catarina, Brazil storms — 671 incidents in 76 municipalities
items.summary: Severe storms Nov 4–5 generated 671 incidents across 76 municipalities in southern Brazil.

physical.note: Quiet week for new physical events; no significant November wildfire reporting found.
